question: What is the Garbhoda ocean and what does it contain beyond Lokāloka?
premises: Beyond Lokāloka lies the Garbhoda ocean, called the king of oceans.
Its measure is equal to that of the seven oceans.
The entire earth is contained within its womb.
inference: Garbhoda is presented as the vast containing ocean in which the whole earth-system rests.
plain_english: Beyond Lokāloka lies the Garbhoda ocean, the king of oceans, equal in measure to the seven oceans. In its womb rests the entire earth.
